library.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: panoramic environment illustration for the existing fantasy deck-building game Panlibrarium, used on welcome, expedition preparation and story prologue screens. Create an atmospheric, hand-painted dark fantasy illustration of an ancient impossible library, arched stone vaults, towering worn bookcases receding into depth, an open illuminated manuscript on a modest reading desk in the lower right third, stray loose pages carried upward in a subtle spiral of luminous ink. Warm antique gold lamplight at edges, midnight indigo shadows, restrained teal ink glimmers. Rich painterly wood and paper, fine ink engraving details, sophisticated storybook atmosphere, no cartoon faces. Landscape 16:9 composition, architectural detail at the edges and right, middle-left dark quiet negative space for separately rendered interface text. Depth and mystery, readable silhouettes, subdued brightness behind UI. The whole scene should be an illustration, not an interface mockup. No people, no lettering, no text, no logos, no watermark, no border.
